{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pinir tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. They grew to considerable heights, and had straight trunks. They grew in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] region of [[Arno (city)|Arno]], on Bellassa.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref>
